sections.title: A quick refresher
sections.content: You already met the days of the week together with the superessive suffix -on/-en/-ön back in A1: hétfőn, kedden, szerdán, csütörtökön, pénteken, szombaton — and vasárnap standing alone with no suffix at all. Nothing new about the pattern itself here, just a refresher before this lesson builds hétköznap and hétvége on top of it.

If szerdán or szombaton trip you up: only szerda's short a genuinely lengthens to á before the suffix (szerdán) — szombat's a isn't word-final so it stays put (szombaton), and kedd's double d was already there in the base word, not created by the suffix.
